articles.summary: EVX-05 is an off-the-shelf therapeutic glioblastoma (brain cancer) vaccine designed based on patient tumor samples. It targets novel conserved antigens identified using Evaxion’s AI-Immunology™ platform Glioblastoma is characterized by high mortality rates and significant unmet medical needs.
articles.title: Evaxion expands and refocuses R&D pipeline with EVX-05, an AI-designed off-the-shelf brain cancer vaccine program
